description: Header file defining memory management functions for the bbfdm context, including initialization, freeing, allocation, reallocation, string duplication, formatted string allocation, and memory block freeing.

methods.name: bbfdm_init_mem
methods.description: Initializes the memory management list within the bbfdm context.

methods.name: bbfdm_free_mem
methods.description: Frees all dynamically allocated memory managed by the bbfdm context.

methods.name: bbfdm_malloc
methods.description: Allocates a memory block of given size and tracks it within the context.

methods.name: bbfdm_calloc
methods.description: Allocates and zero-initializes an array of n elements of size bytes each.

methods.name: bbfdm_realloc
methods.description: Resizes a previously allocated memory block.

methods.name: bbfdm_strdup
methods.description: Duplicates a string and tracks it within the context.

methods.name: bbfdm_asprintf
methods.description: Formats a string and allocates memory for it within the context.

methods.name: bbfdm_free_mem_bloc
methods.description: Frees a specific memory block managed by the context.
